scope: One row per independent causal wait, with early FULL commands and pre-cutoff completion/service.
Latest ACK is limited to transfers that started before completion; after-boundary actions are excluded.
Ten seconds is a diagnostic cohort aligned with the existing maximum service lease, not a new gate.
A long before-completion interval may span several sequential/parallel tools; it is not per-tool prediction error.
Lease release counts are by command; bytes and phases do not prove GPU stall or causal JCT loss.
